name: Colormap Conversion
definition: Maps a scalar tensor to RGB colors using a matplotlib colormap (default 'turbo'). Normalizes input to [0, 1], scales to [0, 255], and indexes into pre-loaded colormap colors.
summary: Colormap Conversion maps scalar data to RGB colors via global linear normalization, distinguishing itself by applying a fixed, dataset-wide scaling rather than per-voxel transfer functions.
